stages.headline: Two numbers the same distance from 0 on opposite sides are opposites: 4 and −4.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two numbers the same distance from 0 on opposite sides are opposites: 4 and −4.

stages.headline: The opposite of a negative number is positive: −(−3) = 3; the opposite of 0 is 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The opposite of a negative number is positive: −(−3) = 3; the opposite of 0 is 0.

stages.headline: The opposite of a is written −a; if a = −7 then −a = 7, so −a is not always negative.
